reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2030
reviews_list.review_title: It's a great college with great teachers.

review_content.Placements: It gives a great placement because it’s a government medical college with 4.5 years of MBBS and 1 year of compulsory internship you have to do. You also have a great opportunity to do MS/MD, which is also a developed portion with a great system.
review_content.Infrastructure: Here the course is MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery), a great course for which a lot of students dream and do everything for it. You have to crack the NEET UG exam with a good rank for admission in this college. Here you will get college after 1st year, which is also great.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best for academics, internships, and placements. It has moderate infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: It has 100% placements. The salary package ranges between Rs. 30,000-75,000 per month. No specific company gives placements but we may directly get into private nursing homes or government jobs. 100% of students get internship opportunities for 1 year and it's mandatory by the government with a current salary of Rs. 43,000 per month. The highest paying internship after MBBS except for AFMC. We may easily get a house stuff ship or private nursing home job or block primary health officer job after MBBS from here.
review_content.Infrastructure: It is more than 100 years old college. The infrastructure is not so good but moderate. Academics here are excellent. Here the library is the largest library among all government medical colleges of West Bengal and Wi-Fi is free here. The hostel infrastructure is poor. There is very good clinical exposure and 4th in OPD patient loads. It has also started its trauma care facility along with a separate super-specialty facility for neuro, cardio, and gastro. It is the best for obstetrics and gynecology all over West Bengal.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: One of the best colleges in West Bengal. Notable alumni members and good facilities at hospital.

review_content.Placements: Once you complete your MBBS you can get placements as RMO in private institutions. Also, if your result is good, you can have a scholarship in different medical colleges. For MD courses, we have huge patient loads. So students can have an apt clinical knowledge combined with good teaching experience.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi assistance is not available. Rooms are airy and spacious. 2-3 members stay in each room. Bathrooms are available. Corridors are cleaned once a week. Mess and canteen are available for food at reasonable cost. Hostel fee is only 12 rupees a month.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: All about Bankura Sammilani Medical College.

review_content.Placements: MBBS graduates are placed as MOs, RMOs, or house staff or go for PG, so they don't need to worry about their placement or salary estimate. House staff has the package of 45000. The PG course has the package of 53,000. Others have the package of 50,000. No one is unplaced after being a doctor from this college, a government medical college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure needs to be updated; lifts are not that much in working order; fans, beds, and bathrooms are not that clean. Though college authority is trying their best to update, there is still a lot of scope for being updated. Security concerns are also there, so security guards and CCTVs are also implemented.

reviews_list.batch_info: General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Bankura Sammilani Medical College & Hospital is good for GNM training.

review_content.Placements: There are 82 students in my class and a total of 270 students in the Nursing Training School. 80 students are doing internships in Bankura Sammilani Medical College & Hospital. There is a stipend system available after the internship, given by the Nursing Council.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is good, with hostel facilities, a demonstration room, a library, an auditorium, and a playground. The college faculty is helpful. Hostel quality is average, with all government facilities such as water and electricity supplied by the government.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: In terms of infrastructure and study scope, my college is such a nice college.

review_content.Placements: Entering MBBS by cracking NEET is the only way to enter medical colleges. In the case of government medical colleges, a cheap amount is spent. Are all final year pass-out students able to get an internship? After passing MBBS, one gets entry into house staffship and then as a junior resident doctor in the same college or another college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is too good, and the facilities are very helpful for students. They also teach more carefully. Here, the library, auditorium, and laboratories are also available. In our college, sports games are available. A huge playground is also there. Boys' and girls' hostels are available, and the mess/canteen is hygienic.

paragraphs: Sardar Patel University (SPU) offers admissionin 200+ degree programmes and diploma courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. It offers programmes in the streams ofScience,Business,Management Studies,Nursing,Arts,Law,Social Work, and many more. Furthermore,SPUalso provides a range of skill-based add-on courses to students. SPU accepts applications through online mode.Sardar Patel University admission criteriafor various courses at the university is merit in the last qualifying examination or the scores in entrance exams. Read the following article to get detailed information aboutSPUVVN admission.

SPU course admissionis entrance-based for all courses.Theuniversity offers admission to various courses based the different criteria, which are either merit in the qualifying exam or the scores obtained by the candidates in the entrance exams accepted by the university. Besides this, the university also conducts an entrance exam for students to get admission to the desired course.The University accepts various national-level entrance exams to shortlist candidates for admission. However, the candidates are required to meet the course-specific eligibility criteria to apply for admission at Sardar Patel University. Students seeking to join the university need to ensure that they go through the multi-step process of admission which includes application, selection, and admission confirmation. Find below the steps to complete theSardar Patel University admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Visit the official website of the university and apply for the desired programme by filling out the application form available online. Students may obtain the form offline from the university campus as well.
Step 2: Selection Process

Students are mainly shortlisted based on national-level entrance tests. Candidates must fulfil the basic eligibility in addition to providing valid entrance exam scores. Some of the entrance exams accepted by the university include CMAT, UGC NET, NATA, etc.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Selected students need to go through document verification and pay the admission fees to secure their spot at the university.

individual_reviews.title: My college is best in other colleges.

content.Placements: In my college and my course, agriculture, the number of students is less, which means 30% of students. In my college, no package is offered. content.Infrastructure: In my course or department, all facilities are available, which means Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. In my college hostel, the food in the mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games facilities are available. In my college, the facilities are so good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Chemistry, Botany, Zoology) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Exploring SBS University facilities, courses, and student life.

content.Placements: SBS University has a dedicated placement cell with a placement rate of 80%-90% of students. The highest salary package offered is 6 LPA. Top recruiters include major firms like Cipla, Jubilant Life Sciences, Coca-Cola, and many more companies.

Wi-Fi is available in hostels. Hostels are secure with CCTV surveillance and 24/7 security. College includes a cricket ground, football field, and basketball courts. Ambulances are available at all time. The college also has badminton courts and other indoor activities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma. Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied but need to improve in management area.

content.Placements: Management needs to work a little bit more in the management part. There were few companies which came for a campus placement drive but we can not assure 100% placement for students and the company which come for the placement drive are from the marketing background. 100% Placement should be there for every student.
content.Infrastructure: SBSPGI infrastructure is very eco-friendly, there is greenery all around and also the college location is in a very peaceful area. Need to modify the classrooms also, very old fashioned classroom and that too with no proper benches, library facility is good, for sports and games there is only a basketball court, need to take care for the other sports also.

courses_data.description: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) at Sardar Bhagwan Singh University is a 54-month course at the UG level. The course offers admission to 60 students. To get admitted to Sardar Bhagwan Singh University Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) course, applicants must meet the entry requirements which is Class 12 with 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: Is internship mandatory to complete the course BPT at Sardar Bhagwan Singh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, to complete BPT course at Sardar Bhagwan Singh university the candidate need to complete an insternhip. Course duration includes 6 months mandatory internship. Apart from this, workshops and seminar are conducted every year by international and eminent national faculty.

faqs.question: What is the BPT course fee at SBS University?
faqs.answer: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) at Sardar Bhagwan Singh University is a 54 months course at the UG level. The course offers admission to 60 students. The total tuition fee for Sardar Bhagwan Singh University Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) is INR 2.53 Lakh. Apart from the tuition fee, there is a one-time admission fee of amount INR 17,500, and a hostel fee of amount INR 3.21 Lacs that students are required to pay in addition to the tuition fee. This information is sourced from official website/

courses_data.name: SBSU Dehradun MPT Admissions 2025
courses_data.description: The university offers three MPT courses which are Sports Rehabilitation, Musculoskeletal and Neurological Disorder. The course duration is two years and aspirants need to complete graduation with 50% aggregate. Admission is through counseling based on the marks obtained in graduation. Provisional admission will be done on the basis of marks obtained in pre-final qualifying examination/entrance test conducted by the university.

faqs.question: What is the MPT course fee at Sardar Bhagwan Singh University?
faqs.answer: The MPT course fee at Sardar Bhagwan Singh University is INR 3 lakh. Aspirants need to pay a one-time fee of INR 17,500. Furthermore, the hostel fee is INR 1.63 lakh. The hostel fee is for year 2023. Meal Plan is not included in mentioned fee. faqs.question: How can I get admission in GHRU Amravati?
faqs.answer: G H Raisoni University Amravati admission is a mix of merit and entrance basis. The university accepts applicants who satisfy the preset eligibility and clear all the steps of the admission process. Students need to fill out the application form and provide the required details along with credentials/ documents to start the process. The university then selects candidates who meet the criteria. Provisionally selected students need to pay the admission fees and go through document verification for seat confirmation.

reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities and mess food were best. The campus, as well as the hostel, had 24 hours of electricity, water, Wi-Fi, CCTV coverage, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is worth taking admission.

But the food in the mess is not good sometimes.

review_content.Placements: Less than 50%. Max package is up to 80k if you get into a really good practice or institute for teaching, and the minimum is 20k. You can do PG courses, private practice, or can be an AMO. 6-month internship is necessary for all the students studying here. Ayurvedic doctor BNYS courses nursing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Not even average. Classrooms and campus building washrooms are way below average; renovation is not done since years. Labs lack instruments and essential equipment required for basic practical knowledge of students. The canteen has not been opened since years. The girls' hostel doesn't have a mess; boys' hostel is a little good.

reviews_list.review_title: It is a perfect college to gain Ayurvedic knowledge and to become an Ayurvedic doctor.

review_content.Placements: Our college provides internships for one year.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good but a little old. It is improving. Our college has several classrooms and rooms for cultural functions. It has a library and a study room for PG and UG scholars differently.
review_content.Faculty: Our college is for 4 and a half years. All teachers are good. They provide good study materials. They are well-trained and have very good skills. Naturopathy and MD courses are available in our college.
review_content.Other: It is an Ayurvedic college. It is a great college. Students are well-trained for the future.

reviews_list.batch_info: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with the course that I am pursuing in my college.

review_content.Placements: Around 30-40% of students get placed just after completing their degree. Other options are we can crack the AIAPGET exam for a PG course that will help us earn more. Big pharmaceutical companies offer jobs for students. All students who passed their final year exam get the opportunity to do internships at their respective colleges with a decent stipend. The surgery course has the best possible salary we can expect in this profession.
review_content.Infrastructure: My college was established in 1946, so as expected, it has that old building. However, classrooms are neat and clean. Wi-Fi is available, and for special video lectures, we have a projector installed in every classroom. The college also has library facilities where students can take their important books for better studies. The hostel is the same as the college building, like an old type. Food is provided by the hostel mess at very affordable rates. It serves good quality food. It is a medical college, so there is no doubt about medical facilities. Sports and games are organised here.

content.Placements: We haven't had any outgoing batches from our college yet, as it is a newly established institution. The first batch, the 2020 batch, is still pursuing graduation here. Pet clinics are also managed by vets, and a wide range of private sectors welcomes talented veterinarians.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostel infrastructure is very impressive. As this is a recently constructed college, we have an advanced hostel with spacious rooms and wide corridors. We also have a good playground and shuttle courts in the hostel. The food in the hostel is comparatively good.

individual_reviews.course: BVSc in Animal Husbandry - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Very good college for those who are determined to be a veterinary doctor.

content.Placements: The placements depend on your GPA at the end of the academic course. Also, the placements in the veterinary department are decided by the government itself. If the government releases any posts, then only you could apply for them and would get a job based on your merit in the college. The highest salary for a beginner would be 30k, and that's an average salary pack too. The internship is offered by the college itself for a span of 6 to 8 months, and it's mandatory for every passed-out student.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are pretty clean and tidy. Each class has a green board along with a projector for smart classes, with a Wi-Fi connection separately for each class and lab. The library is composed of thousands of books regarding this course and also general knowledge too. The labs are well-equipped to assist students in learning quickly. Although the college is good, you can't expect much from a government hostel. Rooms might be clean, but the food isn't up to the mark. Daily cleaning would be there for the rooms, and there would be enough space for 3 persons to share.

review_summary.college_name: Burdwan Medical College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty and large patient in-flow. The infrastructure is under development.

content.Placements: The hospital provides internships with a decent pay better than the other medical colleges. The hospital is loaded with patients, so there’s a large scope of practice. It had recently got a tertiary cancer care centre built near it’s hostel. It is a very demanding and reputed college in West Bengal.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is just okay. There is greenery but some buildings have not been renovated yet, though the work is under progress. 1st year subjects are good but the 2nd year ones are not. The college canteen is not good. It has 3 hostels out of which 2 are inside the campus which are good. One is outside the campus near a slum area which is under renovation.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: On an average it is very good college, it is college of choice after the medical college of Kolkata.

content.Placements: As this is medical college you will get 100% placement, Packages depends on you can earn as much as you want. Here internship is little hectic but it is very useful for our profession. Here you can choose a lots of course but after clearing PG exam.
content.Infrastructure: In our college medical college almost all facility are available it has classroom in good condition, library which is open throughout the day except Sunday and national holiday, it has good food in canteen, sports and games area are also available for student .

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Burdwan Medical College is the epitome of MBBS.

content.Infrastructure: Hostels are so good and eco-friendly. There are so many rooms in it. There are 6 hostels in our college and a PGT hostel. There are 3 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. Each room contains at least 3 students. The college canteens are good. Bathrooms are also hygienic.
content.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They are very skilled and supportive. They have a very unique level of teaching. Our teacher motivates us. The course curriculum is relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are tough and competitive. The pass percentage is about 80% to 90%.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Burdwan Medical College is a good college.

content.Placements: Since it is a government medical college no company comes to us but 100% of students are placed. After completion of 4.5 years, one becomes an intern. During the internship period, we also get a salary of about Rs.28000 per month. We serve the people by treating them.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms are well-equipped. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. PGTS has separate hostels. The rooms are good and well maintained. There is 24*7 electricity and water supply are there. We have an average canteen. There are greeneries and ponds inside campus throughout.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: A good college to fulfill our dreams.

content.Placements: All of the students are doing internships currently in our batch. All are getting 30 thousand rupees as a stipend. Doctors work in hospitals so there is no company. About 100% are doing an internship. Doctors are meant to serve the community and treat patients and hence we're doing that.
content.Infrastructure: All the departments have their respective laboratories and there are 6 lecture theatres, there are two huge libraries. All facilities are present in our hostel including the lift, food is average, and as this is a medical college so medical facilities are always available. All sorts of sports is played in our college including outdoor and indoor games.

review_summary.college_name: GTU Ahmedabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and experienced faculty with affordable fees.

content.Placements: In my course, Mechanical Engineering at LDCE, the placements are quite good. Almost 70% to 80% of students get placed every year. The highest salary package offered is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA, and the average package is about 5 LPA. Top companies like Reliance, Adani, L&T, and Tata Motors come to our campus.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of LDCE is decent. Since it is a very old government college, the buildings look old, but the Mechanical department has big classrooms and well-equipped labs for practicals. The library is vast and contains almost all the books required for our course. Wi-Fi is available in some areas of the campus. I am a day scholar, but my friends say the hostel is affordable and has basic facilities with an average mess. However, the campus has a big ground for sports, and there are facilities for indoor games too. Overall, the campus life is good and very active.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My college faculty is nice and helpful, but placement is below 40 percent.

content.Placements: 30 to 40 percent of students are placed in my course. Right now, I am studying, so I really don’t know about the highest or lowest average package offered after graduation. Many companies are present in the market, so personally, I cannot give exact answers. However, every student is compulsory to do an internship. Top roles are, according to me, QA or scientist level.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very nice for my course. The library and classrooms are nearby and clean. I am not staying in the hostel, but the college canteen food is not bad. Some items are okay, and some of them are nice, it depends on your choice.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best college, best placement and facilities, and decent infrastructure.

content.Placements: They give very nice placement, and almost 80 to 90 percent of students get placed every year. Last year, the highest package is 13.5 LPA, and the average package is 5-6 LPA. Top companies are MICRON, Torrent Power, L&T, Infosys, etc. Almost 99 percent of the students get internship from the Electrical Engineering course. Top roles offered are power systems engineers, control/automation engineers, and renewable energy specialists.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is decent, and facilities are very good. There are Wi-Fi and every equipment in the lab. Hostel is also pretty good, quality of food in the mess and canteen is very good. For sports, there are also many facilities provided, and medical facilities are also good; there is a doctor available.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: This college gives us the best placements.

content.Placements: 80-90 percent of students get placed in my course. The highest package offered is 28 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. The lowest package is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Micron, etc., visit the college for placements in the IT department. Top roles like full-stack developer, mobile app developer, data analyst, etc., are offered here.
content.Infrastructure: BSNL Wi-Fi connections are available in labs. The library is not very big. The library is average with an AC facility. There is a bad infrastructure in the hostel and other buildings. Mess, bathrooms, security, and daily cleaning facilities are available in the hostel. The infrastructure is so bad, but girls' hostel is very nice.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information and Communication Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good academics and infrastructure with decent placements, industry readiness depends on self effort.

content.Placements: Some reports and student reviews suggest placements vary between 60 to 80 percent, depending on the branch. The highest package offered is 22 LPA. Typically, the lowest packages offered are 2.5 to 3 LPA, average package lies around 4 to 5 LPA. TCS, Tech Mahindra, and TatvaSoft Internship ratio: Approximately 50 to 80 percent of students secure internships either through campus drives or independently. Common internship companies include Infosys, Adani, TCS, Torrent Power, Reliance and other tech firms.
content.Infrastructure: Vishwakarma Government Engineering College (VGEC), Ahmedabad has academic blocks, library Computer laboratories. Practical sessions and Mini and major projects are offered. Research and experimentation opportunities are provided. Spacious and well-ventilated classrooms equipped with projectors, whiteboards, and audio systems in many rooms. A large collection of textbooks, reference books, and journals. Access to e resources, e books and digital journals. Reading rooms with a quiet study environment.

faqs.answer: Gujarat Technological University BBA admission for 2025 is merit-based. It considers Class 12 aggregate. individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus environment and infrastructure. Almost all departments have good faculty members.

Food is average, and sports facilities are the worst. It is teaching about hospitals, so medical facilities are available 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: Overall it is a good college.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are good, and the library has Wi-Fi. The campus grounds are nice to walk around after dinner, but there are a lot of dogs and snakes on campus. The campus is also a big ground.

reviews.review_heading: The ideal college in the medical world .
reviews.review_text: The college faculty and facilities are top-notch. The classes are conducted via PPT presentations and a blackboard, making it easy for the students. Libraries are huge, with an enormous amount of books. Hostels are very good with 2 people per room with great food and water facilities. The college is big, which helps the students to get involved in sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: Very old and good college with respect to faculty, facilities and patient load.
reviews.review_text: We have a seminar hall with four classrooms. A big campus, a playground, every department and hospital is within the campus, a canteen near the hospital, spacious campus with good safety,  24 hrs library with a digital library which is open in the morning hours.

Our college is one of the oldest college of Karnataka and was established in year 1961 so the building are quite old but now there is lots of new classes been built but the departments are some what old. reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi facility throughout the whole campus. Also, labs and classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. reviews.review_text: Well-oriented library for both study and research purposes, catering to UG, PG, and higher levels. Well-equipped labs are present, and classrooms are advanced with projector screens, Wi-Fi, and comfortable benches and desks. Hostel facilities are above average with good food and accommodation. reviews.review_text: We have air-conditioned lecture halls, a library with all new editions of the latest reference books, and national standard laboratories for all different departments like Anatomy, Physiology, etc. The hostel is clean with 3 people sharing per room. Air conditioning is presented but no one bothers to fix it. The hostel also has several broken showers and the management is not bothered.

reviews.review_heading: I am somewhat satisfied with the hostel but everything is good.

The number of seats will be increased to 250 from 150 in 2022. Hostel rooms are so congested and bathroom facilities are very poor. There are only 3 toilets for 40 boys.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has great faculty and infrastructure but I am dissatisfied with college life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. All the departments have their dedicated labs, demonstration rooms, lecture halls, PG rooms, and research labs. Wi-Fi is available but connectivity is limited. Quality food is available but for sports, there is not much scope.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has excellent teaching standards and sports facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have an excellent library facility. Weekly journals of international and Indian standards are available. There are well-equipped labs and classrooms and are air-conditioned. The hostel is average and there are spacious rooms. Food served is way better than other colleges. We have very good sports facilities and daily practices for various sports. Reduction is given to students for medical checkups.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced campus life with strong academics.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure with well maintained labs, classrooms and library facilities qith Wi-Fi. The attached hospital provides strong clinical exposure. Hostel rooms are clean with basic amenities and the mess food is decent. The campus facilities support both study and clinical training well. Sports including cricket football and indoor games like badminton are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, studying on this campus is worth it. Campus life is never a problem if you join KMCT.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure for MBBS students. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with audio-visual aids. Wi-Fi is available everywhere in the college. Hostels are clean and secure with basic furniture. Food is better compared to other PGs and hostels. Wi-Fi is also available in the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and 150+ alumni.
reviews.review_text: The rooms were always clean and well-connected with the wardens. The food was average. The college conducted several games and curricular activities each year. There were good medical facilities in case we were hospitalized. In the evenings, we always played some outdoor games, and the weather was nice.
